description: Optimize the cubic Fd-3m bulk structure of silicon.
user_prompt: Optimize the cubic (Fd-3m) bulk structure of silicon (Si). Report the final converged energy and lattice constant.

references: Jain, Ong, Hautier, Chen, Richards, Dacek, Cholia, Gunter, Skinner, Ceder & Persson, APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013)
method.modeling: Diamond Si conventional cubic bulk cell with space group Fd-3m; Si formula unit is one atom.
method.rationale: The target energy is the Materials Project mp-149 GGA final energy per atom (-5.4234 eV/atom), equal to energy per formula unit for elemental Si. Only the total energy is scored; the lattice constant is left as a diagnostic because the accepted energy is tied to MP PAW/PBE conventions. Si is a semiconductor, so metallic Methfessel-Paxton smearing should be avoided; the +/-0.5 eV/f.u. absolute tolerance covers PAW dataset, cutoff, and smearing differences while still flagging qualitatively wrong bulk calculations.
